description.value:
War, to the Tactical Specialist, is a discipline to be studied as rigorously as any craft. They pore over old campaigns, master unfamiliar tools, and drill until every maneuver becomes second nature, treating the battlefield as a puzzle to be solved rather than a chaos to be endured.

This scholarly devotion pays off in versatility: a Tactical Specialist reads an opponent's strengths and weaknesses at a glance and answers with exactly the right technique. Their true gift lies not in raw power, but in knowing precisely how and when to apply it.
